_about: The camp save (scripts/camp/camp_save.gd): JSON with a version number, a backup of the previous save and migrations. new_camp is the whole-year layout every save starts from; a save missing any key gets it from here when loaded. Profiles are keyed by profile ID, never a connection ID. couch marks a character made on the host's couch that no PC has claimed yet; link_code lets its own PC claim it once. last_seen (Unix seconds) picks who drops in on the couch. Stage A (version 2): coins starts at the new camp's coins; stays are the guests in the camp now (data/day.json); last_settled is the day number of the last night that paid, so a night never pays twice; a version 1 camp with no ledger yet gets the starting coins. Stage B (version 3): reservations are the advance bookings (data/guests.json) with their state (offered, accepted, arrived, declined, done) and arrive_day; a stay may carry its request and booking; pockets hold item ids (data/fishing.json). looks are the camper models handed to new profiles, least-used first.
